## Probe #14 residual batch + tagged rebuild

Builds on **0.1.23** / tip `56ab61a` (probe #13 mid-cycle). Inspection rounds since v0.1.23 reached 3 → tagged rebuild.

### Critical fixes
- **Compare body paint** — panes showed chrome (“Hunk N of M”, labels) but blank white bodies. Root cause: `h_flex()` centers on the cross axis, so panes collapsed to label height and floated mid-screen; scroll regions got zero height. Fixed with `items_stretch` + `h_full` and per-line `pane_view` (unit-tested).
- **Drag-tab → second editor group** — dropping a tab on the editor’s right/bottom edge did nothing (D0≡D1). Edge strips set a preview but had no `on_drop` (drops do not bubble). Strips now accept the drop, widen to 40px, and **move** the tab into a real secondary group (not MD edit|preview `Layout::Split`). Empty groups still collapse on close; Close Editors in Group scopes to the focused group.
- **Split Editor Right** — toolbar button + existing command as a reliable alternative when drag fails.

### Discoverability / reliability
- Command palette: **Select for Compare** / **Compare with Selected** (were explorer-only → “No matching commands”)
- Tab context menu: Select for Compare / Compare with Selected
- Active document fallback when palette/tab invokes compare without an Explorer selection
- After Terminal focus, Ctrl+P / Quick Open opens the chosen file (no longer Untitled via lost `dispatch_action`)

### Already accepted (unchanged)
Settings filter, Outline rank+Python, Problems empty CTA, Welcome CTAs, hide words/min-read on code, Ctrl+B, Terminal, bulk close, AS-aware Compare toast.

### Deferred / soft
- Welcome Open Recent enablement when the same profile has recents (already wired; isolated HOMEs correctly stay disabled)
- Status language picker / encoding click targets (language dropdown + encoding label already present)
